Talview for Product Leaders
AI-Powered Proctoring for Scalable Digital Assessments
Book a Demo
2500+ Global Recruiters in Amazing Companies Like These Use Talview
As digital assessments grow, product teams need secure, scalable, and user-friendly proctoring solutions that integrate effortlessly. Many existing tools create friction in UX, privacy concerns, and engineering overhead. Talview’s AI-powered remote proctoring enables product leaders to offer a seamless, secure, and privacy-first exam experience without disrupting test-takers or slowing down development teams.
Key Challenges for Product Teams
Scalability & Performance
Legacy proctoring tools struggle with high test volumes, accessibility, and latency — leading to test disruptions and poor user experiences.
Frictionless UX & Privacy Compliance
Candidates expect an intuitive, low-friction exam experience, while compliance with
GDPR, FERPA
, and global privacy laws is non-negotiable.
Fraud Prevention & AI Accuracy
Balancing accurate cheating detection with minimal false positives is critical, especially for
high-stakes certifications
and assessments.
LMS & API Integration Complexity
Engineering teams need seamless integration with
LMS platforms
and existing workflows — without extensive development effort or complex APIs.
How Talview Can help You
Seamless API & LMS Integration
Plug-and-play integration with
Moodle, Blackboard, Canvas, and custom platforms
, reducing development overhead.
Gen AI Powered Cheating Prevention
Advanced face recognition, monitoring, and behavior tracking to detect impersonation and fraud in real-time.
Privacy-First Proctoring
GDPR & FERPA-compliant, ensuring data protection without intrusive monitoring.
Scalable & Adaptive Performance
Cloud-based,
optimized for high test volumes
with low bandwidth support.
Customizable for Your Product (White Labelled)
White-label solutions that match
your platform’s UI/UX
, creating a
native experience
for users
